_comment: Declarative contract for structural environment expectations — the DEFAULTS layer of cross-machine path resolution (ADR-025). Read by `dotf doctor`/`dotf env generate`. Per-machine overrides live in ~/.config/dotfiles/machine.json; `dotf env generate` resolves env -> machine.json -> these defaults (per OS) and renders paths.sh/paths.ps1 that the shell profiles source. v1 covers structural paths only; tooling-required vars and version pins live in versions.conf and secrets/registry.yaml.

env_vars.name: DOTFILES_DIR
env_vars.description: Stable install location of dotfiles deployed by setup-linux.sh. Used by dotf doctor and shell profiles.

env_vars.name: DOTFILES_REPO_DIR
env_vars.description: Repo source-of-truth for dotfiles (BUG-020). Distinct from DOTFILES_DIR which is the deployed copy. Used by dotf doctor (CLI-019 repo/deploy drift check) to locate the git repo; without it the drift check cannot resolve the repo root and SKIPs.

env_vars.name: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
env_vars.description: Override for Claude Code's config dir. When unset, ~/.claude is assumed. Canonical for Claude (upstream contract — Claude Code CLI reads it at startup); intentionally NOT renamed to CLAUDE_HOME (see REFACTOR-002).

env_vars.name: SCRIPTS_DIR
env_vars.description: Deployed scripts directory. Used by RC files to extend PATH and by dotf doctor for script location lookups.

env_vars.name: AGY_HOME
env_vars.description: Antigravity CLI config dir. Deployed by setup scripts from ai/agy/.

env_vars.name: COPILOT_HOME
env_vars.description: GitHub Copilot CLI v2 config dir. Deployed by setup scripts from ai/copilot/ when the `copilot` binary is detected.

env_vars.name: OPENCODE_HOME
env_vars.description: OpenCode config dir (XDG-style, intentionally inconsistent with the .X pattern because that is where OpenCode deploys per its schema). Deployed by setup scripts from ai/opencode/.

env_vars.name: VAULT_PATH
env_vars.description: Obsidian knowledge vault root — the cross-machine path seam (ADR-025). Honored by `dotf vault`/`dotf init`, the session-start hooks, and the Go vault resolver. Per-machine overrides live in ~/.config/dotfiles/machine.json; `dotf env generate` renders it into paths.{sh,ps1}.

env_vars.name: HIVE_VAULT_PATH
env_vars.description: Vault path the Hive MCP daemon (`hive serve`) reads at start. Mirrors VAULT_PATH by default (same vault); declared separately because the daemon reads its own env (ADR-025).

env_vars.name: AGE_KEY_PATH
env_vars.description: Age identity key path — the ADR-028 DR root-of-trust. Read by the dotfiles age flow (secrets.ageKeyPath cascade) and rendered into paths.{sh,ps1} by `dotf env generate`, so every shell discovers the key with zero per-shell config. Deliberately carries NO path_exists validation: a freshly provisioned box legitimately has no key until it is restored offline, and the WARN-level `dotf doctor` presence check — not a hard env-contract FAIL — owns 'key missing' (#518).

env_vars.name: SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE
env_vars.description: Identity path the `sops` binary reads to auto-discover the age key. Fixes #518: on a fresh box SOPS defaults to ~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt, so with this unset every `sops` decrypt failed silently until it was exported by hand. Points at the same deployed key as AGE_KEY_PATH and is rendered into paths.{sh,ps1} by `dotf env generate`. No path_exists validation, for the same fresh-box reason as AGE_KEY_PATH.

env_vars.name: HOME
env_vars.description: POSIX home directory. OS-provided; validated as a real directory.

env_vars.name: USERPROFILE
env_vars.description: Windows home directory. OS-provided; validated as a real directory.

required_binaries.name: jq
required_binaries._pattern_note: regex must be valid in both bash ERE (no `(?:..)`) and .NET; capture group 1 holds the version. Group 2 is intentionally captured-but-unused for the optional patch component.

optional_binaries.name: npm
optional_binaries.purpose: Node package manager (obsidian-cli, yarn, global tooling)

optional_binaries.name: gh
optional_binaries.purpose: GitHub CLI (PR/issue management; Copilot CLI is the standalone `copilot` binary, not a gh extension since BUG-003)

optional_binaries.name: copilot
optional_binaries.purpose: GitHub Copilot CLI (agentic assistant; winget GitHub.Copilot on Windows, manual install on Linux)

optional_binaries.name: uv
optional_binaries.purpose: Python tool installs (hive-vault, general Python workflows)
